instruction: Stand the yellow pen upright in the magenta pen holder.

attempts.code:
# Grasp the pen
candidates = grasp_candidates("yellow_pen")
c = min(candidates, key=lambda cand: abs(cand["squeeze_width"] - 0.012))
grasp(c)

# Retrieve holder info
obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]
rim_h = holder.get("rim_height", 0.08)

# The pen is held horizontally across the gripper fingers (along `side`).
# To make it upright (vertical along z), we tilt the gripper horizontally so `side` points along z.
# If approach = [1, 0, 0] and finger_axis = [0, 1, 0], then side = approach x finger_axis = [0, 0, 1] (vertical).
carry_to(hx, hy, height=0.25)
move_gripper(hx, hy, hz + rim_h + 0.12, approach=[1, 0, 0], finger_axis=[0, 1, 0], path="joint")

# Lower the vertical pen into the holder
move_by(dz=-0.08)
open_gripper()
retreat(dz=0.15)
go_home()
check("yellow_pen", "magenta_holder")

obs = observe()
holder = obs["zones"]["magenta_holder"]
hx, hy, hz = holder["center"]

# The robot is currently holding yellow_pen.
# Pen lies along side = approach x finger_axis.
# For side=[0, 0, 1] (pen pointing up/down), choose approach and finger_axis in horizontal plane.
# Test orientations via solve_ik to ensure reachability.

    ([0, -1, 0], [1, 0, 0]),
    ([0, 1, 0], [-1, 0, 0]),
    ([-1, 0, 0], [0, -1, 0]),
    ([1, 0, 0], [0, 1, 0]),
]

chosen_app, chosen_fax = None, None
for app, fax in orientations:
    sol = solve_ik(hx, hy, target_z, approach=app, finger_axis=fax)
    if sol["reachable"]:
